blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Barangay Ginebra moved on the verge of advancing to the semifinals after blowing out San Miguel Beer, 126-99, to take a 2-0 lead of their 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series on Friday at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. Import Jordan Murphy once again played a major role in the Gin Kings’ victory, posting 33 points, 10 rebounds and nine assists in repeating over the Beermen. But it was also Ginebra’s outside shooting that saw them connect on 16 triples, nine coming from RJ Abarrientos and Stephen Holt, that left San Miguel helpless throughout the contest.
